# commander_address (Resource)

Creates and manages a Keeper `address` record in the vault.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Record title.

### Optional

- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Manage custom fields for the record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `notes` (String) Manage note for the record.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Share the record with users. Map keys are **email addresses**; values specify `can_share` and `can_edit` permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `state` (String) State or province.
- `street1` (String) Street address line 1.
- `street2` (String) Street address line 2.
- `zip` (String) Zip or postal code.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `type` (String) Keeper field type (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`, `phone`, `name`, `date`).
- `value` (String) Field value; for complex types use `jsonencode(JSON)` matching the [Keeper field schema](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/secrets-manager/about/field-record-types).

Optional:

- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether to mark the value as sensitive in Terraform state display.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Required:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit the record.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share the record with others.
